A clinical trial is a research study in which animals with cancer participate to evaluate aspects of, or novel treatments for, cancer. Well-designed clinical trials can answer questions about preventing, detecting, and treating cancer that help many animals in the future. Trials are designed to minimize risk to the participants, but drug trials often involve new anti-cancer agents that may not have been used in companion animals, and the extent of possible toxicity is not known.
